markdown: This check has crossed from merely slow into a poor dependency decision: one small generic lemma upstream forced `FibreWindowEquiv` to consume about 47 GB and more than 20 CPU-minutes. I’m stopping this build, relocating the lemma into the new conjugacy module that consumes it, and restoring `HighWindowKoszul` exactly; that preserves the mathematics while avoiding a workspace-wide recompilation cascade.
